_description: Machine-readable documentation of navigation component structure. See nav_engine/navigation.js for the orchestrator.

menu_button._description: Sidebar panel visibility toggle and responsive show/hide logic
files: navbar_visibility_handler.js — initNavbar(), show/hide sidebar, responsive breakpoint logic
navbar.css — all sidebar panel and button styling (485 lines)
nav_history_buttons.js — back/forward navigation buttons with URL stack tracking

admin_and_user_tools._description: Registry of custom views (admin tools + user tools) loaded into navigation
files: custom_views.js — custom_views[] array mapping view names to load functions

database_tree._description: Sidebar navigation menu: collapsible groups, tree view for admin tools
files: nav_builder.js — create_navigation_buttons(), update_active_heading(), admin tree builder

main_tabs._description: Horizontal SVG tab bar at the top of the sidebar
files: tabs.js                     — initTabs(), openNavTab(), SVG tab rendering, auth filtering
tab_icon_library.js          — Material Symbols SVG path registry (getTabIconPath)
tab_reorder_drag_and_drop.js — drag-and-drop tab reordering with API persistence

nav_engine._description: Core navigation engine: orchestration, routing, URL params, history
files: navigation.js        — orchestrator: imports all subfolders, exports public API
query_params.js      — URL/localStorage param management (most imported file externally)
history_navigation.js — popstate handler for browser back/forward
recently_viewed.js   — tracks and highlights recently used nav tabs
